title: ProjectE authoritative pin/package source — an EXPLICITLY DECLARED record, not a datasheet extraction

mpn.$comment: The MPN whose asset is being qualified. It is an INPUT. bom-lifecycle selects parts; this record and the tool reading it never do.

package_code.$comment: The manufacturer's own package designator (e.g. DRL0006A), not a generic family name. 'QFN-40' is a shape; a package code is an identity, and the wrong-variant substitutions this gate exists for are between two parts that share a shape.

expected_footprint_name.$comment: A token that the candidate .kicad_mod's own (footprint "NAME" ...) must contain. THIS PROVES LABELLING, NOT GEOMETRY — a file can be named anything. It is checked because disagreement between the label and the measured geometry is the signal; agreement alone is not evidence. Absent => the attribute is excluded and the run caps at CONFIRM.

pins.$comment: The authoritative pin table. An EMPTY array is not 'a part with no pins' — it is read as 'the pin universe could not be read', which produces NO_COVERAGE with eligible>0 and scanned=0. It never produces GREEN and it never produces a mass RED against the candidate.

pads.$comment: The authoritative pad/land table. Same empty-array semantics as pins.

package_dimensions.$comment: RECORDED, NOT VERIFIED. Body outline and pitch are not derived from a .kicad_mod by this tool: a body outline lives on fab/silk layers whose contents are a drawing convention, and a pitch inferred from pad centres guesses the row structure. Publishing an unverified number as if it were measured is the failure mode; these fields are carried into the report labelled as declared-only. The VERIFIED geometry is land_pattern.pad_span_*.

exceptions.$comment: An exception removes an item from the SCANNED population, which is exactly the move that turns a gate into a formality. So it is accepted only with a non-empty reason AND a complete five-field provenance block of its own. A refused exception is not dropped: the item stays scanned, the refusal is reported and it adds a CONFIRM cap — writing an unevidenced exception makes the report louder, never quieter.

$comment: OPEN QUESTION, DELIBERATELY LEFT OPEN (2026-08-10). Which artifact is the canonical repo-wide authoritative pin/package source for ECAD qualification is NOT decided. This schema does NOT claim to be it. It is the contract for an EXPLICITLY DECLARED, human- or vendor-authored record: a person read the manufacturer document, transcribed the table, and signed the transcription with provenance. There is no PDF parser, no OCR and no heuristic table scraper behind it — inventing a datasheet-extraction format and then treating its output as ground truth is the fabricated-source failure this bundle is built against. Until the canonical artifact is chosen, a run whose source is not provenance-complete reaches CONFIRM at best and can never reach GREEN.

document_id.$comment: The manufacturer's own document number (SLVSF74C), not a file name.

revision.$comment: Pin tables get renumbered between revisions. 'the datasheet' is not a citation.

locator.$comment: Where inside the document: table number, section, page. A reader must be able to go and check the transcription without reading the whole document.

snapshot_sha256.$comment: Digest of the snapshot document this record was transcribed FROM. Pass that document as --source-snapshot to have it verified; a mismatch is STALE. Without --source-snapshot the digest is recorded and reported as verified=null — declared but unchecked.

transcription_method.$comment: How the table got into this file: manual, vendor_supplied, ... Whatever it was, it was not this tool.

provenance.$comment: skills/_shared/coverage-gate.md, evidence_origin table, AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE row: document_id + revision + locator + accessed + snapshot_sha256 are ALL mandatory. Any one missing and the record is a note, not a source: the run caps at CONFIRM.

number.$comment: String, not integer: BGA balls are A1/AK24 and exposed pads are 'EP'. An integer type here would force a lossy conversion on exactly the parts this gate matters most for.

name.$comment: THE EXACT NAME THE SYMBOL PIN MUST CARRY. Compared literally after stripping surrounding whitespace — no case folding, no ~{X} overbar rewriting, no alias table. A normaliser is precisely where a wrong pin quietly becomes a right one, so if the symbol writes ~{RESET} the author writes ~{RESET} here.

function.$comment: Human-facing description from the document, carried into the report so a RED says what was actually swapped ('pin 1: expected VIN (input supply), symbol has GND'). Not machine-compared: the symbol file has no field to compare it to — name is that field.

electrical_role.$comment: KiCad's electrical pin types verbatim, because that is the token the .kicad_sym contains. Mapping datasheet prose onto one of these is the SOURCE AUTHOR's declaration; the tool never guesses it. This is what catches an EN pin typed 'input' against a variant where pin 4 is a no_connect.

type.$comment: KiCad's pad types verbatim, same reason as electrical_role. This is an IDENTITY claim (is this the right kind of land?), not a manufacturability claim — NSMD/SMD, paste coverage and mask geometry belong to dfm.

present.$comment: true means the document specifies a thermal/exposed pad. A footprint without it is then the wrong package variant — the failure cad_assets.py names in its own header, which passes ERC and DRC and is found on the first soldered board.

symbol_pin_number.$comment: The EP must exist on the SYMBOL side too. A footprint EP with no corresponding symbol pin cannot be tied to GND (MASTER_RULEBOOK Faz 1) and ERC will not complain, because there is nothing there to complain about.

source_type.$comment: PREFER the manufacturer land pattern whenever one exists. Only 'manufacturer' (with document_id and revision) leaves a run eligible for GREEN. 'ipc_derived'/'local_library'/'vendor_ecad' WITH a derivation recorded is LOCAL_POLICY; the same without a derivation is SCREEN_ONLY. 'none'/'unknown' is CONFIRM. If a manufacturer application note contradicts a generic footprint rule, the application note wins and no compromise geometry is synthesised.

derivation.$comment: REQUIRED IN PRACTICE for any non-manufacturer source_type: the technique and its parameters, e.g. 'IPC-7351B nominal, density level M'. Absent, the report cannot say what the pattern was derived from and drops to SCREEN_ONLY.

tolerance_mm.$comment: MANDATORY whenever pad_span_* is given. There is no default: a tolerance nobody sourced is a number this tool invented, and a comparison against an invented tolerance is not a measurement. Without it the span attributes are excluded and the run caps at CONFIRM.

land_pattern.$comment: pad_span_* are CENTRELINE spans — the distance between the outermost pad CENTRES, exposed pad excluded — because that is what can be read out of a .kicad_mod without guessing pad-edge conventions. If the document quotes lead-tip extents instead, do not transcribe them here: they are a different measurement, and quoting one as the other is INVALID_METRIC under gate_receipt.schema.json.

item.$comment: The pin number, pad number, or attribute name (footprint_name / pad_span_x_mm / pad_span_y_mm).
